title: lists the mode and the operator again while the engine is back and the feed is read again
why: The cell keeps its reading through a restart: back and reading again, it leaves the rows out for pickers the panel does not draw, and the mode and the operator are said nowhere.

title: lists them again once a read of the feed is refused
why: A refused read keeps the reading before it: the rows stay out while the panel shows its refusal and no picker.

title: lists the stored mode and operator while a refused choice is said
why: The panel's refusal not handed to the cell: the pickers show the refused choice and the stored mode is said nowhere.
